review_ep03.verdict: Ep03 holds up. Facts and attribution are clean. Picture follows the narration almost everywhere, the camera makes smooth planned moves without hunting, and all five director hero moments land. There are no must-fix items. Two should-fixes: (1) the Mabrey contrast "权力 · 无" arrives on the segment's last word and is on screen for only about 1.3 s before the cut; (2) the "两个目标" chapter opens on a near-empty wide frame for about 4 s. Two nits: a 5-s static hold in the Clarify scene, and the only dashed "absence" boxes in the episode (Lonsdale "未提"). On-screen copy matches the ledger, including "每周至少一次 · 一到两小时", which Ferriss #384 states as "an hour or two, at least once a week". Hero moments: the flood widens from the man to his email to every inbox (0:24–0:35). The head fills with notes that fly out into calendar days, with the 按时查看 return arrow (1:45–2:01). Mom goes from one word to a project and a next action (2:46–3:00). The Allen and Lonsdale rows line up gate by gate (3:32–3:45). The reading diagram goes from close to wide (5:27–5:45). The weekly-review break also lands: weeks 4–6 go red and the 下一步 tags fade (4:03–4:08).
strongest: Mail flood (0:24–0:35, sheet-01): the camera widens with the story, from the man to his email to all ten inboxes. Bars pile in, then the screen splits into 被邮件淹没 and 设过滤规则, with the blue filter line clearing the right half. It returns as the same diagram in 回到驻场 (5:00–5:12) with the opposite emphasis.

Head to calendar (1:45–2:01, sheet-03): the same notes that crowd the enlarged 脑子 fly out one by one into calendar days, and the last day sends the blue 按时查看 arrow back. One object stays the same object through the change.

Allen vs Lonsdale (3:32–3:45, sheet-06): Allen's chain slides up into a comparison row. The dashed skip arrow and the two 未提 slots under the blue 下一步已定 / 本来就要做 show exactly which premises the one-line mention drops.

Weekly review breaking (4:03–4:08, sheet-07): the 回顾 chips drop out of weeks 4–6, their borders turn red, and the 下一步 tags fade with 系统过时 · 方法被放下. Red is used correctly for a break the source reports.
Evidence table (4:42–5:00, sheet-08): Allen 的说法 | 研究出处 with 未给出 / 未读 / 未找到 states the episode's limits plainly, with no hedging.
